description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of ResourceModifiedStrategy in handling ResourceModified events concerning policies, focusing on creation of new resources with labels, and ensures proper assertions on the modified Policy object.

classes.name: ResourceModifiedStrategyCreateTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing ResourceModifiedStrategy with resource modification events, extending AbstractPolicyEventStrategyTest for ResourceModified type.

methods.name: getStrategyUnderTest
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of ResourceModifiedStrategy to be tested.

methods.name: getPolicyEvent
methods.description: Constructs and returns a ResourceModified event with given timestamp and policy, simulating a resource modification event.

methods.name: additionalAssertions
methods.description: Performs assertions on the policy after applying the event, verifying that new resources with a specific label are added and existing labels are unchanged.
